## #8 — tg_jp — 2008-10-31
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/467/post-25702>

hi, thank you for trying this script.

you have to set 'polygon selection' manually at material tag of object. a number 'materials' of Random Array script is a number of material you can assign to object. if a number is 4, you can assign 4 materials to object and you have to set 'polygon selection' property of material tag (0 to 3). please check attached sample scene file.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto

Attachments: [Cheetah3D_sz_003.jpg](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/5900/), [randomArray_sample.jas.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/5901/)
